Netcore Unbxd is an AI-powered product discovery platform recognized by Forrester and Gartner as the global leader in Commerce

Search and Product Discovery, earning Leader status in Gartner's 2025 Magic Quadrant™ for the second consecutive year. We're

trusted by billion-dollar retailers like Unilever, Waitrose, Express, Puma, Signet, and Advance Auto Parts to power conversions and

revenue through best-in-class product discovery and personalization. We're at the forefront of Agentic AI in commerce — building AI

Shopping Assistants and Autonomous Merchandising Agents that redefine how shoppers find what they want.


﻿﻿﻿Curious what it's like to work here? Check out Life at Netcore - Life at Netcore

Also Please have a look at our Founder's take on where we're headed: https://www.founderthesis.com/p/rajesh-jain-and-netcore-cloud-the



What you'll do


As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Platform team, you will design, build, and operate the core infrastructure that powers AI capabilities across Unbxd's products.

You’ll work on large-scale backend systems while exploring and productionizing the latest advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, vector search, and multimodal retrieval.


Your work will include:


Designing and building scalable AI platform services and backend systems.

Developing agentic workflows using modern LLM frameworks.

Developing services around embedding models, reranking models, and multimodal search.

Exposing AI models and algorithms as highly available internal services (ISVCs/APIs).

Designing systems for model lifecycle management, inference, experimentation, and evaluation.

Building orchestration frameworks for AI workflows and long-running jobs.

Improving observability, reliability, scalability, and performance of AI infrastructure.

Collaborating closely with Search, Product, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to ship production-ready AI features.

Driving architecture discussions and owning services end-to-end.



What we're looking for



Must Have

✔ 5+ years of experience building large-scale backend or platform systems.

✔ Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages:

Java/ Python/ Golang

✔ Strong understanding of:


●       Distributed Systems

●       System Design

●       Scalability

●       Performance Optimization

●       Concurrency



✔ Experience designing and operating microservices in production.

✔ Hands-onexperience with containerized deployments using:

●       Docker

●       Kubernetes


✔ Experiencewith asynchronous systems such as:

●       Kafka

●       RabbitMQ

●       Event-driven architectures


✔ Experience building REST/gRPC APIs and production backend services.

✔ Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures.

✔ Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

✔ Ability to independently own services and drive projects from design through production.



AI Platform Experience


Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:


●       LLM orchestration

●       Agentic workflows

●       Prompt engineering

●       Embedding models

●       Vector databases

●       Semantic search

●       Model evaluation

●       AI workflow orchestration

●       Model serving



Practical experience building production AI systems is preferred over academic knowledge.

Global Lead - Sales Enablement

Location: Mumbai | Function: Sales Enablement |


Why This Role Matters:


The Sales Enablement Lead is at the heart of our growth engine - you'll make sure our Sales, Presales, and SDR teams have everything they need to succeed. From coaching and content to tools and insights, you'llhelp our teams tell better stories, sell smarter, and win more.

Think of this role as being the strategic partner who turns information into action - helping our revenue teams transform potential into performance.


What You'll Do:

- Build and execute a world-class Sales Enablement strategythat helps our sales teams sell with confidence and clarity.

 -Train and coach teams on product knowledge, sales methodologies, negotiation techniques, and handling objections like a pro.

- Create impactful playbooks, success kits, competitive battle cards, and pitch decks that make sellig easier and more engaging.

- Work hand-in-hand with Marketing and Product teams to ensure the sales story aligns perfectly with our brand and solutions

- Dive into sales data and metrics to spot trends, uncover bottlenecks, and identify areas where we can level up performance.

- Mentor Sales and SDR Trainers, ensuring seamless collaboration and continuous skill development across teams.

- Be ready to jump into customer calls when needed - to learn, observe, and bring fresh insights back to the team.

- Keep your finger on the pulse of the latest sales tools and enablement trends, ensuring we always stay one step ahead.


What We're Looking For:

- Around 7+ years of experience in Presales, or SolutionEngineering, with at least 5+ years in Sales Enablement or a similartraining-focused role.

- Someone who's built and run successful enablement programs from concept to measurable results.

- A great communicator and storyteller who can turn complex information into clear, motivating narratives.

- Skilled in coaching and facilitation, with an understanding of how adults learn best.

- Comfortable with Sales tech stacks like CRMs, enablement platforms, and analytics tools.

- Data-minded - you believe in tracking impact, not justactivity.

- Bonus if you've led teams before or worked in a SaaS or B2B tech setup.


Bonus Points If You:

Already know Netcore products or the martech ecosystem

Can bring fresh, creative ideas for driving engagement and performance.

Thrive at the intersection of strategy, learning, and technology.


Why Join Netcore?

Netcore is the unified Customer Experience Platform (CEP) empowering 6500+ global brands — including PhonePe, and BigBasket — to deliver hyper-personalized journeys at enterprise scale. Our AI-powered stack spans a

robust Customer Data Platform (CDP), omnichannel orchestration (email, SMS,WhatsApp, push, web), and predictive analytics for lifetime value optimization.

We've driven 5x engagement lifts and $500M+ in client revenue uplift for retail, fintech, and telco giants worldwide.

At Netcore, we're not just another SaaS company - we're theglobal driving force behind how brands connect with their customers everysingle day.

For over 25 years, we've helped businesses deliver personalized and meaningful engagements that go way beyond simple marketing.

Our AI-powered Customer Engagement & Experience (CEX) platform helps brands understand their customers, predict what they love, and create unforgettable journeys across email, mobile, web, app, and WhatsApp.

From iconic global labels like Tommy Hilfiger, Crocs,nHamleys, KFC, McDonald's, and The Body Shop, to powerful digital-first brandslike Nykaa, Zivame, and HDFC Life, over 6,500+ companies trust Netcore to grow their business.

Every month, our platform sends over 20 billion emails,tracks 120 trillion marketing interactions, and helps brands turn data intodelightful experiences. If you want to be part of a company that's shaping how millions experience brands every day - this is where you belong.

Join us and you'll help shape products used by leading global brands, working alongside a high-performing design and product team that values craftsmanship, experimentation, and continuous learning. At Netcore, growth isn't a buzzword —it's the culture. You'll work on cutting-edge AI/ML products alongside some of the sharpest minds in Martech, in an environment where what you deliver matters more than how long you've been around. It's fast-paced, ambitious, and offers

real ownership from day one.


If you're passionate about creating software that doesn't just work, but feels exceptional — we'd love to hear from you.

  • Life at Netcore — culture, and employee


What drives us?

-Work with intelligent, passionate people who love solvingreal-world business problems.

-Freedom to create, experiment, and innovate with new ideas that can directly impact thousands of businesses.

-A fast-paced yet supportive environment where growth is constant and learning never stops.

-The chance to shape how modern sales enablement is done at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world.
